<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">It
is anticipated that the investigation of specific business opportunities and the negotiation, drafting and execution of relevant agreements,
disclosure documents and other instruments will require substantial management time and attention and substantial cost for accountants,
attorneys and others. The costs that will be incurred are difficult to determine with any degree of specificity at this time as such
costs are expected to be dependent on factors such as the amount of time it takes to identify and complete a Business Combination

in the transaction, possible changes in the Company&rsquo;s capital structure in connection with the transaction, and whether funds may
be raised contemporaneously with the transaction. If a decision is made not to participate in a specific business opportunity, the costs
theretofore incurred in the related investigation might not be recoverable. Furthermore, even if an agreement is reached for the participation
in a specific business opportunity, the failure to consummate that transaction may result in the loss to the Registrant of the related
costs incurred. The Company has identified Conwall as its proposed Business Combination target. Completion remains subject to
the amended Business Combination Agreement, applicable approvals and other closing conditions.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>Emerging
Growth Company</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company is an &ldquo;emerging growth company&rdquo;, as defined in the Jumpstart Our Business Startups Act of 2012 (&ldquo;JOBS Act&rdquo;),
and may take advantage of certain exemptions from various reporting requirements that are applicable to other public companies that are
not &ldquo;emerging growth companies&rdquo; including, but not limited to, not being required to comply with the auditor attestation
requirements of section 404(b) of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act, and exemptions from the requirements of Sections 14A(a) and (b) of the Securities
Exchange Act of 1934 to hold a nonbinding advisory vote of stockholders on executive compensation and any golden parachute payments not
previously approved.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company has elected to use the extended transition period for complying with new or revised accounting standards under Section 102(b)(1)
of the JOBS Act. This election allows us to delay the adoption of new or revised accounting standards that have different effective dates
for public and private companies until those standards apply to private companies. As a result of this election, our financial statements
may not be comparable to companies that comply with public company effective dates.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Our
emerging growth company status is subject to the statutory five-year limit following our initial public offering and may end earlier
if our annual gross revenues are $1.235 billion or more, we issue more than $1 billion of non-convertible debt in a three-year period,
or we become a large accelerated filer under Exchange Act Rule 12b-2.&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">To
the extent that we continue to qualify as a &ldquo;smaller reporting company&rdquo;, as such term is defined in Rule 12b-2 under the
Securities Exchange Act of 1934, after we cease to qualify as an emerging growth company, certain of the exemptions available to us as
an emerging growth company may continue to be available to us as a smaller reporting company, including: (1) not being required to comply
with the auditor attestation requirements of Section 404(b) of the Sarbanes Oxley Act; (2) scaled executive compensation disclosures;
and (3) the requirement to provide only two years of audited financial statements, instead of three years.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>Shell
Company Status</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>&nbsp;</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">We
are a &ldquo;shell company&rdquo; as defined in Rule 405 of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the &ldquo;Securities Act&rdquo;)
and Rule 12b-2 under the Exchange Act. The term shell company means a registrant, other than an asset-backed issuer as defined in Item
1101(b) of Regulation AB, that has no or nominal operations and either no or nominal assets, assets consisting solely of cash and cash
equivalents, or assets consisting of any amount of cash and cash equivalents and nominal other assets.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Some
of the consequences of being a shell company are as follows:</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Rule
    145a under the Securities Act provides that any direct or indirect business combination of a reporting shell company (that is not
    a business combination related shell company as defined in Rule 405) involving another entity that is not a shell company is deemed
    to involve an offer, offer to sell, offer for sale, or sale within the meaning of section 2(a)(3) of the Securities Act of securities
    to the reporting shell company&rsquo;s existing shareholders. Where Rule 145a applies, that deemed offer and sale would need to be
    registered under the Securities Act, unless there is an applicable exemption. The proposed Conwall Business Combination contemplates
    a separate registration statement on Form F-4 covering the transaction. This Form 10 registers BRAC&rsquo;s common stock under the
    Exchange Act and does not itself register the offer or sale of the transaction securities under the Securities Act.</FONT></TD></TR>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>Blank
Check Company</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>&nbsp;</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">We
are a &ldquo;blank check company&rdquo; as defined under Rule 419 of the Securities Act, as amended. Rule 419 imposes certain restrictive
requirements on offerings of securities by blank check companies. However, we have no present intention of engaging in an offering of
our securities that would be subject to Rule 419 while we remain a blank check company. We anticipate raising funds through an offering
of our securities only upon completion of a business combination as a result of which we would no longer be a blank check company. Therefore,
we do not anticipate that the provisions of Rule 419 will deter a potential target company from entering into a business combination
transaction with us.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

effectiveness of this registration statement, we intend to maintain compliance with Exchange Act reporting requirements. We may seek
quotation of our securities on an over-the-counter market; however, there can be no assurance that a market maker will file an application
for quotation, that quotation will be approved, or that an active trading market will develop.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B><A NAME="ju_005"></A>Conwall
Business</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>&nbsp;</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B><A NAME="ju_006"></A>Holdco
Corporate Structure</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>&nbsp;</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Holdco
is an exempted company with limited liability incorporated under the laws of the Cayman Islands on 12 February 2026 solely for
the purpose of effectuating the Business Combination described herein. Holdco intends to report as a foreign private issuer, subject
to satisfying the applicable Rule 405 and Exchange Act Rule 3b-4 tests described under Item 5.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Upon
incorporation, Holdco has an authorized share capital of US$50,000.00 divided into 500,000,000 ordinary shares of US$0.0001 par value
each. Upon incorporation, Holdco had one ordinary share in issue. Following the July 2026 reorganization and September 8, 2026 repurchase
and cancellation, the Conwall equity-holder block comprises 24,670,924 issued and outstanding Holdco Ordinary Shares. Holdco&rsquo;s
ordinary shares have a par value of $0.0001 each; the transaction exchange and capitalization terms are described in the pro forma notes
and the amended Business Combination Agreement. The objects for which Holdco is established are unrestricted and Holdco has full power
and authority to carry out any object not prohibited by the laws of the Cayman Islands.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Following
the September transactions, the holders of the Conwall equity-holder block are Ng Boon Teik, Jingji Hu, ENSP Limited, HK Xingfu
Capital Holding Limited and Haibiao Deng. Upon Closing, the Holdco Board will consist of no fewer than seven directors,
of whom (i) one will be designated by BRAC and (ii) six will be designated by Holdco, of whom a majority will qualify
as &ldquo;independent directors&rdquo; under the stock exchange regulations applicable to Holdco.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
July 16, 2026, Boon Teik Ng and Jingji Hu held 21,000,000 and 9,000,000 of our ordinary shares, respectively. On September 8, 2026, we
repurchased and cancelled 3,730,353 ordinary shares from Mr. Ng and 1,598,723 ordinary shares from Mr. Hu, for aggregate nominal consideration
of US$533. In respect of advisory services rendered, on September 8, 2026, (i) Jingji Hu transferred 1,480,255 ordinary shares to ENSP
Limited, (ii) Ng Boon Teik transferred 986,837 ordinary shares to HK Xingfu Capital Holding Limited, and (iii) Jingji Hu transferred
986,837 ordinary shares to Haibiao Deng. As a result of these transfers and repurchases, Boon Teik Ng and Jingji Hu held 16,282,810 and
4,934,185 of our ordinary shares, respectively, as of September 8, 2026.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

following discussion describes Conwall Construction Industries Sdn. Bhd. (&ldquo;CCISB&rdquo;), the Malaysian operating subsidiary of
Conwall Construction Industries Limited (&ldquo;Holdco&rdquo;), the proposed parent following the Business Combination. References to
&ldquo;we,&rdquo; &ldquo;our,&rdquo; &ldquo;us&rdquo; and the &ldquo;Company&rdquo; in this subsection mean CCISB. Completion of the
Business Combination remains subject to its closing conditions.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B><A NAME="ju_007"></A>Overview</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">CCISB,
a Malaysian private limited company, was incorporated on October 8, 2019, under the Companies Act 2016 of Malaysia. The Company&rsquo;s
principal office is located at: No. 25 &amp; 27, Lorong Valdor Jaya 3, Golden Gateway Perindustrian Valdor, 14200 Pulau Pinang, Malaysia.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">CCISB
is a specialized high-technology facility infrastructure company providing cleanroom engineering, process utility systems, controlled-environment
construction, facility integration, maintenance, engineering and project delivery services. We mainly serve semiconductor, advanced manufacturing
and other technology-oriented customers who require high-tech production facilities and controlled manufacturing environments. For a
discussion of the risks associated with our dependence on these customers and their capital expenditure cycles, see &ldquo;Risk Factors
&mdash; Demand for our services depends substantially on industry capital expenditures, which are cyclical, difficult to predict and
affected by customer investment decisions.&rdquo; and &ldquo;Risk Factors &mdash; Customer concentration, project concentration and non-recurring
project revenue may cause significant volatility in our results.&rdquo;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B><A NAME="ju_008"></A>Corporate
History</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">We
were incorporated in Malaysia on October 8, 2019, under the Companies Act 2016 of Malaysia, as a private company limited by shares, and
commenced operations in 2021 by providing construction and maintenance services.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
October 8, 2019, the Company was incorporated with a total share capital of RM250,000 divided into 250,000 registered shares with a
par value per share of RM1.00. Through a cash consideration, Jingji Hu acquired 75,000 ordinary shares and Ng Choon Wah acquired
175,000 ordinary shares.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
July 10, 2020, we allotted a further 500,000 ordinary shares to Jingji Hu and Ng Choon Wah, with the former acquiring 150,000 ordinary
shares and the latter acquiring 350,000 ordinary shares, by cash consideration.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
May 31, 2023, Ng Choon Wah transferred all 525,000 of his ordinary shares to Boon Teik Ng for the cash consideration of RM525,000.00.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
July 16, 2026, Conwall Construction Industries Limited (&ldquo;Holdco&rdquo;) entered into a share swap agreement (as supplemented from
time to time) with the stockholders of CCISB, Jingji Hu and Boon Teik Ng. Pursuant to the agreement, Mr. Ng exchanged 525,000 CCISB shares
for 21,000,000 Holdco Ordinary Shares, and Mr. Hu exchanged 225,000 CCISB shares for 9,000,000 Holdco Ordinary Shares. Upon completion
of the share swap, Holdco became the sole stockholder of CCISB. On September 8, 2026, Holdco repurchased an aggregate of 5,329,076 Holdco
Ordinary Shares from Mr. Ng and Mr. Hu for nominal value, following which 24,670,924 Holdco Ordinary Shares remained issued and outstanding.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B><A NAME="ju_009"></A>Our
Business</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">CCISB
is a specialized high-technology facility infrastructure company providing cleanroom engineering, process utility systems, controlled-environment
construction, facility integration, maintenance, engineering and project delivery services. We mainly serve semiconductor, advanced manufacturing
and other technology-oriented customers who require high-tech production facilities and controlled manufacturing environments.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: center"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>Business
operations segments and project visibility</B></FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">CCISB
operates one reportable segment, construction and maintenance services, focused on cleanroom, precision HVAC, process utilities, mechanical
and electrical integration and related high-technology facility infrastructure. All fiscal 2026 and June-quarter revenue was generated
in Malaysia. Since commencing operations in 2021, it had completed 53 projects with individual contract values of at least RM100,000
and had 12 such projects in progress at June 30, 2026.</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">GAAP
remaining performance obligations were $53,447,887 at March 31, 2025, $18,062,490 at March 31, 2026 and $7,605,215 at June 30, 2026.
Management expects the June balance to be recognized within twelve months, subject to execution and contract terms. For the June quarter,
$18,062,490 opening backlog plus $769,503 of new binding awards and approved variations, less $7,278 of cancellations and scope adjustments,
less $11,286,729 of revenue, plus $67,229 of currency translation equals $7,605,215.</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Backlog
measures unperformed committed work under binding contracts and excludes quotations, prospective projects and unapproved, cancelled or
disputed portions. It is an operating measure, not GAAP revenue or cash. Its definition may differ from GAAP RPO because of enforceability,
variable consideration and scope. The detailed rollforward in Item 2 reconciles the disclosed amounts to RPO. Preliminary geographic
expansion and Clean Room as a Service plans are not current revenue or committed backlog.</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>Customer
and project concentration</B></FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">For
the year ended March 31, 2026, Chipbond Technology Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. accounted for approximately 79.1% of Conwall revenue. One Chipbond
project generated $52,024,368, or approximately 77.4% of $67,259,375 total revenue, and gross profit of $6,341,627, a margin of approximately
12.2%. It was 91.72% complete at March 31, 2026; two other Chipbond projects were completed during the year.</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">For
the three months ended June 30, 2026, Coherent Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. generated $7,479,374, or approximately 66.27%, and Chipbond generated
$2,785,205, or approximately 24.68%, of total revenue of $11,286,729. Together they represented approximately 90.95%. Projects are awarded
individually; completion or a prior award does not ensure renewal or follow-on work. The runoff of the large Chipbond project creates
a need for replacement awards, and timing, customer investment decisions and collections may materially affect revenue and liquidity.
All revenue in both periods was Malaysian.</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>Competition
and project awards</B></FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"> Conwall&rsquo;s competitors, principal competitive
factors and East Asia sourcing network are described below under &ldquo;Competition.&rdquo; Competitive tendering, execution
capacity and price remain material to its ability to obtain profitable awards. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Customers
generally evaluate technical experience, prior project references, safety and quality qualifications, ability to mobilize qualified personnel,
procurement capability, schedule, price and financial capacity. Conwall&rsquo;s quotation process does not guarantee an award; management
describes approximately three months from quotation to award and approximately one week from award to mobilization, depending on the
project. In fiscal 2026, 205 awards from 705 quotations represented approximately 29.1% by count and 13.2% by value. These historical
ratios are not forecasts.</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Larger
contractors may have greater financial resources, bonding capacity and execution experience. Competitive tendering and negotiated pricing
can put pressure on margins, particularly where materials, subcontract labor and schedule risks cannot be passed through to customers.
Conwall&rsquo;s technical specialization and supplier network do not assure future awards or profitable performance.</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>Personnel
and subcontractors</B></FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Conwall
had 54 full-time employees at June 30, 2026: 33 in operations, seven in commercial functions, five in sales, marketing and business support,
and nine in general and administration. Conwall also reports a workforce of 54 as of the date of this registration statement, comprising
50 local and four foreign employees. The foreign employees hold valid work permits, employment passes or other required immigration documents,
renewable under applicable law. The departmental breakdown is measured at June 30; these employee counts exclude subcontractor personnel.</FONT> </P>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Project
delivery also depends on subcontractors, outsourced specialists and qualified engineers and project managers. Key personnel include Ng
Boon Teik, Chief Executive Officer; Lim Chong Hin, Chief Operating Officer; Kam Lian Hooi, Chief Financial Officer; and Jingji Hu in
construction and engineering leadership. Loss of personnel, restrictions on foreign-worker approvals, permit expiration, rising labor
costs or subcontractor nonperformance could delay work and reduce margins. Conwall generally uses employment and confidentiality agreements
and reports no material labor dispute.</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>Properties
and manufacturing facility</B></FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Conwall&rsquo;s
operating office arrangements include the related-party Keyone Property Development Sdn. Bhd. lease discussed in Item 7, at RM30,000
monthly, with the disclosed renewal period through June 30, 2027. Other disclosed premises include No. 5, Jalan Ekoperniagaan 2/4, Taman
Ekoperniagaan, 81100 Johor Bahru, and 28A, Laluan Lapangan Siber 1, Bandar Siber, 31650 Ipoh, Perak. As of September 18, 2026, Conwall
intended to terminate the Ipoh tenancy by two months&rsquo; notice or rent in lieu, subject to operational requirements.</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
manufacturing property at No. 2 Lorong Valdor Jaya 4, Taman Perindustrian Valdor Jaya, 14200 Sungai Jawi, Pulau Pinang has approximately
153,228 square feet of floor area and a contractual RM38 million purchase price. At June 30, 2026, RM36.1 million had been paid and RM1.9
million remained; construction was incomplete, title had not transferred, and the payments were classified as construction in progress.
A Certificate of Occupancy was issued September 10. Conwall paid the final RM1.9 million on September 22, 2026, settling the purchase
price in full, and reports that construction is complete. These developments are reflected in interim Notes 4, 10 and 15. Title transfer
is not established by payment or occupancy certification.</FONT> </P>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
September 17, 2026, Conwall entered into a third-party lease commencing November 24, 2026. The property was intended for prefabricated
construction components; Conwall elected to lease it pending finalization of its manufacturing processes. The RM purchase-price bridge
is exact. U.S. dollar carrying amounts use accounting and transaction exchange rates and should not be added across different dates as
though a single translation rate applied.</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>Material
registration and licensing status</B></FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
October 5, 2026, CCISB terminated its CIDB Grade G7 local-contractor registration following the July 16 share swap that made it a subsidiary
of Cayman Islands Holdco. It then applied for foreign-contractor registration. Conwall states that the application remains pending and
that no penalty has been received. The former certificate&rsquo;s stated May 6, 2026 to July 27, 2029 period does not make that terminated
local registration currently effective. Approval timing, grade, categories, specializations and conditions of the replacement registration
are uncertain.</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
former CIDB registration covered Building Works B04, Civil Engineering Works CE01 and CE21, and Mechanical Engineering Works M15. Conwall
reports a valid Penang business-premises and advertising licence, number PRI/01/20230526/6331, for No. 25 and No. 27, Lorong Valdor Jaya
3, valid from November 21, 2024 through December 31, 2026. Conwall also reports a valid Johor Bahru licence as of June 15, 2026 for No.
5, Jalan Ekoperniagaan 2/4; a specific renewal date is not provided here. The Ipoh premises have no valid premises and advertising licence.
Their June 24, 2026 application remains under consideration, and tenancy termination was contemplated on September 18, subject to two
months&rsquo; notice or rent in lieu. Conwall reports no penalties at these locations as of the date of this registration statement.
Foreign workers and site personnel must maintain the applicable immigration, employment and CIDB credentials. Pending applications do
not establish operating authority.</FONT> </P>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>Regulatory
framework and compliance exposure</B></FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Conwall&rsquo;s
Malaysian operations are subject to contractor registration and project declarations under the CIDB framework; building completion and
occupancy requirements; local premises and advertising licenses; employment, immigration and foreign-worker approvals; workplace safety
and health duties; and statutory provident-fund, social-security, employment-insurance and minimum-wage obligations. These requirements
affect tender eligibility, deployment of workers, occupation of premises and project execution. The detailed applicable laws and disclosed
requirements follow in &ldquo;Government and Industry Regulations.&rdquo;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Project
performance also involves environmental and site controls, waste and pollution requirements, anti-bribery obligations, and protection
of employee, customer and project information. Cybersecurity incidents, mishandled personal data, corrupt payments or regulatory noncompliance
could result in claims, investigation, remediation costs, loss of licenses or project eligibility, and reputational damage. The terminated
local CIDB registration, pending foreign registration and Ipoh license application described above are specific compliance exposures
and are not covered by a blanket statement of compliance.</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Compliance
entails registration and renewal fees, levies, employee contributions, safety personnel and training, monitoring and remediation costs.
These costs are included in the appropriate operating or project expenses; the financial information included here does not separately
quantify a comprehensive compliance-cost amount. The CIDB regime described below imposes a 0.125% levy on construction work exceeding
RM500,000, subject to applicable exemptions. The financial statements do not isolate actual levy and other compliance expenditures; the
statutory rate is not an estimate of total compliance cost. Pending licensing matters may generate additional costs or operating restrictions
that have not been quantified.</FONT> </P>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>Proceedings
and disputes</B></FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Conwall
states that it is not a party to, and management is not aware of a threat of, legal or administrative proceedings likely to have a material
adverse effect on its business, financial condition, cash flows or results. This disclosure should be read with the specific regulatory
and licensing matters above and the contingencies notes to its financial statements. It does not eliminate risks from ordinary-course
construction claims, liquidated damages, customer disputes, labor matters or tax examinations.</FONT> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
of June 30, 2026, CCISB had completed 53 construction and facility infrastructure projects, each with a contract price of at least $24,038
(RM100,000), since commencing operations in 2021 and had 12 additional projects in progress. Our projects are primarily located in Malaysia,
where we have established experience and relationships with customers in the semiconductor and advanced manufacturing sectors. For the
fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 and the three months ended June 30, 2026, all of our revenue was generated from projects in Malaysia,
and we did not generate any revenue from outside Malaysia during these periods. See &ldquo;Risk Factors &mdash; All of our revenue is
generated in Malaysia, and our planned expansion into other Southeast Asian markets may not succeed.&rdquo; and &ldquo;Risk Factors &mdash;
Customer concentration, project concentration and non-recurring project revenue may cause significant volatility in our results.&rdquo;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B><A NAME="ju_010"></A>Competition</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">We
operate in an increasingly competitive industry that is rapidly evolving. We compete with specialized engineering and cleanroom infrastructure
contractors such as Polycool THE Engineering Sdn Bhd, IAQ Engineering Sdn Bhd and Hong Poh Engineering Sdn Bhd.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">We
believe the principal competitive factors in our market include semiconductor project expertise; the ability to manage technically complex
projects without compromising manufacturing readiness; schedule reliability; cleanroom and contamination-control capabilities; process
utility and M&amp;E expertise; experience in supporting advanced packaging capabilities; access to skilled and qualified personnel; established
supplier and procurement networks; and local presence and customer relationships.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">We
believe we compete favorably on the factors described above. In particular, we believe our competitive strengths include our experience
in high-technology facility infrastructure projects, particularly for semiconductor and advanced manufacturing customers, our ability
to integrate cleanroom, process utility and M&amp;E works, and our track record of delivering technically complex projects within customers&rsquo;
required schedules. Since commencing our construction and maintenance services in 2021, we have completed 53 construction and facility
infrastructure projects, each with a contract price of at least $24,038 (RM100,000), and had 12 additional projects in progress as of
June 30, 2026. We also believe our established customer relationships, understanding of semiconductor facility requirements and ability
to coordinate multiple engineering and construction disciplines enable us to respond effectively to customers&rsquo; project requirements
and support timely project delivery.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
addition, we have developed a broad sourcing network across East Asia, which enables us to identify and procure equipment, materials
and other project resources from a wider range of suppliers and may provide us with cost competitiveness in project execution.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Despite
our competitive strengths, we anticipate that larger Malaysian general contractors and construction groups may directly compete with
us for projects. Many of our current and potential competitors have longer operating histories, greater financial resources, bonding
capacity and large-project execution experience. These factors, together with uncertainty regarding customer investment, procurement
decisions and semiconductor cyclicality, may intensify competition and lead competitors to adopt lower prices, making it difficult for
us to secure projects on acceptable terms. If we are unable to compete effectively, our business, financial condition and results
of operations will be adversely affected. See &ldquo;Risk Factors &mdash; Competition from specialized M&amp;E contractors and
larger general contractors may reduce project awards, pricing and margins.&rdquo; and &ldquo;Risk Factors &mdash; We compete for project
awards on the basis of a limited number of reference projects and customer qualifications, and we may be unable to win new work on commercially
acceptable terms.&rdquo;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B><A NAME="ju_011"></A>Insurance</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">CCISB
maintains insurance coverage that it believes is relevant for its businesses and operations. The Company maintains commercial general
liability, motor vehicle insurance, workmen&rsquo;s compensation, construction insurance covering contractor all risks and erection all
risks, public liability insurance, employee insurance covering term life, crisis cover, accidental death, accidental medical, among other
coverage. We also purchase fire, burglary and business insurance, covering our inventory and fixed assets such as equipment and tools
of trade. We also maintain business inconvenience insurance. We believe that our insurance coverage is in line with industry standards
and is adequate to cover our key assets, facilities and liabilities. See &ldquo;Risk Factors &mdash; Our insurance coverage may be insufficient
to cover project claims, professional liability, property loss or business interruption.&rdquo;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B><A NAME="ju_012"></A>Intellectual
Property</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As

trademarks will expire between 2033 and 2035.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">We
typically enter into employment agreements and confidentiality agreements with all our full-time employees. In addition, we impose non-compete
covenants on our senior management and core personnel, which prohibit them from competing with us, directly or indirectly, during his
or her employment and for six months after termination of employment. We believe that we maintain a good working relationship
with our employees, and we have not experienced material labor disputes in the past. See &ldquo;Risk Factors &mdash; Our ability to execute
projects depends on our ability to hire, retain and deploy qualified engineers, project managers and technical personnel.&rdquo; and
&ldquo;Risk Factors &mdash; We depend on foreign labor, and increases in levies, quotas or immigration restrictions could increase our
costs or delay our projects.&rdquo;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><A NAME="ju_040"></A><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>New
Business Initiatives</B></FONT></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Management
is also evaluating a proposed expansion into a Clean Room as a Service, or CRaaS, data-center infrastructure model. The proposed CRaaS
model is intended to build on our experience in cleanroom engineering, controlled-environment construction, mechanical and electrical
systems, power distribution, cooling, commissioning and facility delivery. Under this model, we would seek to prepare or co-develop move-in
ready, environmentally controlled, high-specification data-center facilities or related infrastructure for customers that require reliable,
scalable and rapidly deployable computing-center capacity. This initiative remains preliminary and is not treated as current revenue,
signed backlog or committed customer demand unless and until supported by definitive land rights, power allocations, network access,
governmental approvals, financing commitments and customer contracts. See &ldquo;Risk Factors &mdash; Our proposed CRaaS data-center
infrastructure strategy is preliminary and may expose us to capital-intensive development, financing, leasing, utilization and operating
risks that differ from our historical EPC business.&rdquo;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B><A NAME="ju_014"></A>Government
and Industry Regulations</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">CCISB
is subject to the general laws in Malaysia governing businesses including labor, occupational safety and health, licensing and other
similar laws. Compliance with these laws and regulations is essential to our operations and to maintaining the licenses and approvals
required for our business. See &ldquo;Risk Factors &mdash; Failure to comply with environmental, workplace safety, building, construction,
tax, labor or licensing regulations could adversely affect our operations.&rdquo; and &ldquo;Risk Factors &mdash; Changes in Malaysian
government policy, taxation and licensing requirements could increase our costs or restrict our ability to bid for projects.&rdquo;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B><I>Lembaga
Pembangunan Industri Pembinaan Malaysia Act 1994 (&ldquo;CIDB Act 1994&rdquo;)</I></B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
CIDB Act 1994 governs the establishment of CIDB and provides for its function in relation to the construction industry and all matters
connected therewith.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Pursuant
to Section 25(1) of the CIDB Act 1994, a person may not carry out or undertake construction work, or hold itself out as a contractor,
unless it is registered with CIDB and holds a valid certificate of registration issued by CIDB. Under Section 29 of the CIDB Act 1994,
any person who contravenes Section 25(1) commits an offence and shall, on conviction, be liable to a fine of not less than RM10,000 and
not more than RM100,000.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 28; Value: 2 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="text-align: center; width: 100%"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->28<!-- Field: /Sequence --></TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%"><TR><TD STYLE="text-align: center; width: 100%">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
this regard, contractors must comply with various regulatory requirements imposed under the CIDB Act 1994, including obligations relating
to the declaration and submission of construction contracts awarded to them, as well as the payment of levy to CIDB in respect of construction
contracts exceeding RM500,000 at the prescribed rate of 0.125% of the contract sum. Contractors are further required to fully disclose
all information affecting their levy obligations and to comply with prescribed timelines for such submissions. Failure to comply with
such requirements may result in the imposition of fines of up to RM50,000 or other penalties as prescribed under the CIDB Act 1994.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
addition, Section 34B of the CIDB Act 1994 imposes general duties on contractors undertaking construction works, including the obligation
to submit information and supporting documents relating to construction works as required by CIDB, to ensure compliance with the CIDB
Act 1994 and all applicable laws, regulations and conditions imposed by CIDB, and to ensure the safety of construction works during and
after completion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
October 5, 2026, CCISB terminated its</FONT> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"> CIDB Certificate
of Registration as a Grade G7 local contractor following the July 16, 2026 share swap. Before termination, that registration
permitted projects without a tender-value limit in Building Works B04, Civil Engineering Works CE01 and CE21, and Mechanical
Engineering Works M15. CCISB then applied for foreign-contractor registration; the application remains pending, and its timing, grade,
categories, specializations and conditions are uncertain. </FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
terminated local CIDB certificate stated a validity period from May 6, 2026 to July 27, 2029; that printed
expiry date does not establish current authority following its October 5, 2026 termination. Under the terms and conditions of its
registration, the Company is required, among others, to comply with CIDB Act 1994 and all regulations, conditions and restrictions imposed
by CIDB from time to time, undertake construction works only within its registered categories and specialisations, submit notifications
and information relating to construction contracts within the prescribed timeframe, display its registration details as required, ensure
compliance with applicable codes of conduct and ethics, and appoint appropriately skilled and accredited construction personnel and site
supervisors. The Company is also required to ensure that all construction personnel at its sites possess valid CIDB Construction Personnel
Cards.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">CIDB
may suspend, revoke or cancel a contractor&rsquo;s registration in the event of non-compliance with applicable laws, breach of registration
conditions, provision of false or misleading information, abandonment of construction works without reasonable cause, or other prescribed
grounds under the CIDB Act 1994 and its regulations.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
July 16, 2026 share swap placed CCISB under the ownership of Cayman Islands Holdco. Following termination of local-contractor registration
on October 5, CCISB applied for foreign-contractor registration. The application remains pending and Conwall reports no penalty
received. A lapse, restriction or delay in obtaining authority may affect existing projects, new tenders and revenue; the
ability to continue affected construction activities must be assessed under the applicable requirements. </FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B><I>Street,
Drainage and Building Act 1974 (&ldquo;SDBA 1974&rdquo;) and Uniform Building By-Laws 1984 (&ldquo;UBBL 1984&rdquo;)</I></B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
SDBA 1974 regulate laws relating to street, drainage and buildings in local authority areas in Peninsular Malaysia. It provides for the
requirement to have a Certificate of Fitness for Occupation (&ldquo;CFO&rdquo;) or a Certificate of Completion and Compliance (&ldquo;CCC&rdquo;)
to ensure that a building is safe and fit for occupation.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">UBBL
1984 has been put into force pursuant to the exercise of the powers conferred by the SDBA 1974. Under the UBBL 1984, a CFO or a CCC in
respect of a building shall be issued upon satisfaction of amongst others, the following requirements:</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(a)
the qualified persons (i.e. the architect, registered building draughtsman or engineer) (&ldquo;Qualified Persons&rdquo;) have certified
that they have supervised the erection of the building and that the building has been constructed in accordance with the relevant laws
and regulations and any conditions imposed by the local authority;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(b)
the building has been constructed in accordance with the UBBL 1984 and any conditions imposed by the local authority have been satisfied;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(c)
the Qualified Persons accept full responsibility for those portions which they are respectively concerned with; and</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(d)
all essential services have been provided.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Any
person who occupies or permits to be occupied any building or any part thereof without a CFO/CCC shall be liable on conviction to a fine
not exceeding RM250,000 or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 10 years or to both.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B><I>Local
Government Act 1976 (&ldquo;LGA 1976&rdquo;)</I></B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Pursuant
to Section 102 of the LGA 1976, local authorities in Malaysia are empowered to regulate and supervise trades, businesses and industries
within their respective jurisdictions through the issuance of by-laws, including licensing requirements for business premises and related
activities.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Under
Section 107 of the LGA 1976 and the relevant local authority by-laws, no person may carry out any trade or business or use any premises
for business purposes without obtaining a valid business premise licence issued by the relevant local authority. In addition, where applicable,
separate licences may be required for the display of advertisements or signage at business premises.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
Johor Bahru, the Company&rsquo;s operations are subject to the Undang-Undang Kecil Pelesenan Tred, Perniagaan dan Perindustrian (Majlis
Bandaraya Johor Bahru) 2016 and the Undang-Undang Kecil Pelesenan Iklan (Majlis Bandaraya Johor Bahru) 2010. These by-laws require that
no person shall use any premises within the Johor Bahru City Council area for any trade, business or industrial activity, or exhibit
any advertisement, without first obtaining the requisite licence issued by the Mayor. The Johor Bahru by-laws also empower the local
authority to impose licence conditions, require compliance with specified requirements, and order the closure of any premises operating
without a valid licence until such licence is obtained or renewed. Non-compliance with these requirements constitutes an offence and
may result in a fine not exceeding RM2,000 or imprisonment for a term not exceeding one (1) year, or both, and in the case of a continuing
offence, a further fine not exceeding RM200 for each day during which the offence continues after conviction. As of June 15, 2026, the
Company holds a valid Business Premise and Advertisement License for its premises located at No. 5, Jalan Ekoperniagaan 2/4, Taman Ekoperniagaan,
81100 Johor Bahru, Malaysia.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
Ipoh, the Company&rsquo;s operations are subject to the Licensing of Trades, Business and Industries (Ipoh City Council) By-Laws 2017
and the Licensing of Advertisement (Ipoh City Council) By-Laws 2013. These by-laws similarly require that business and industrial activities,
as well as the display of advertisements, be carried out only upon obtaining the relevant licences from the local authority. Failure
to comply with the applicable licensing requirements constitutes an offence and is punishable by a fine not exceeding RM2,000 or imprisonment
for a term not exceeding one (1) year, or both, and in the case of a continuing offence, a further daily fine may be imposed. As of June
24, 2026, the Company has submitted a new licence application for the Company&rsquo;s Ipoh premises located at 28A, Laluan Lapangan Siber
1, Bandar Siber, 31650 Ipoh, Perak. Further, as of September 18, 2026, the Company intends to terminate the Ipoh premises tenancy agreement,
subject to commercial and operational requirements. Termination is expected to be effected by giving two (2) months&rsquo; written notice
or payment of two (2) months&rsquo; rental in lieu, in accordance with the tenancy agreement, and the Company does not expect such termination
to have a material adverse impact on its business or financial condition.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
Penang (Seberang Perai), the Company&rsquo;s operations are governed by the Municipal Council Province Wellesley Licence Fees By-Laws
1980 (License Fees By-Laws 1980) and the Municipal Council of Province Wellesley (Advertisement) By-Laws 2001 (Advertisement By-Laws
2001). Under the Licence Fees By-Laws 1980, it is an offence to operate any licensable item specified in the schedules thereto without
a valid licence issued by the President of the Council, and any contravention of the said by-laws or of any condition imposed thereunder
is punishable by a fine not exceeding RM2,000 or imprisonment for a term not exceeding one (1) year, or both, and in the case of a continuing
offence, a further fine not exceeding RM200 for each day during which the offence continues after conviction. Under the Advertisement
By-Laws 2001, no advertisement may be exhibited except under and in accordance with a licence issued by the Council, and any contravention
of the said by-laws or of any notice or order of the Council is punishable by a fine not exceeding RM2,000 or imprisonment for a term
not exceeding one (1) year, or both. Where the Council approves the retention of an advertisement which has been exhibited without a
licence, a fee equivalent to three (3) times the annual license fee is payable, and the Council may in addition order the removal or
erasure of the advertisement and recover the costs of removal from the person in default. The Company holds a valid Business Premise
and Advertisement Licence for its premises located at No. 25 and No. 27, Lrg Valdor Jaya 3, Golden Gateway Perindustrian Valdor, 14200
Sungai Jawi, Pulau Pinang, under licence number PRI/01/20230526/6331, valid from 21 November 2024 to 31 December 2026. The said licence
has been duly complied with and remains in force as at the date of this registration statement.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
addition, certain administrative matters, including internal restructuring and partition of premises where applicable, are being undertaken
by the Company in its premises. These activities may also be subject to similar licensing requirements imposed by the local authorities.</FONT></P>
